claims_supported: Parallel change/expand-and-contract splits an incompatible interface change into expand, migrate and contract phases.
Old and new interface versions coexist; clients migrate incrementally; the old version is removed at contract.
claims_not_supported: Parallel Run as a named or defined pattern
same work processed concurrently by old and new implementations
output comparison, side-effect suppression, divergence owner or runtime commit rule
limitations: Unit supports Parallel Change only, not Parallel Run.
